issues.description: Method 'messageOnFeed' on abstract class Animal: the problem statement UML declares it as public abstract (+ messageOnFeed():String) (problem_statement.md line 28), but the reference solution declares it as protected abstract (solution/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Animal.java line 18). This visibility mismatch can confuse students about the intended access level and method signature (whether implementations should be public), and may lead to inconsistent implementations or test expectations.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the abstract method visibility consistent. Preferred: change the declaration in solution/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Animal.java to 'public abstract String messageOnFeed();' so it matches the UML and problem statement. Alternatively, update the UML/problem statement to indicate 'protected' visibility if that is the intended design.
